description:
Perform the annual survey rollover for the Employee Pulse survey. 

1. Copy the existing 'Employee Pulse 2024' survey to a new survey titled 'Employee Pulse 2025'. 
2. In the new survey, delete the obsolete question group '2024 Initiatives'. 
3. Create a new question group titled '2025 Strategic Focus'. 
4. Add two questions to this new group: 
   - Code: 'AI_USAGE', Text: 'How frequently do you use Generative AI tools in your daily work?', Type: List (Radio), Options: Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Never. 
   - Code: 'INNOVATION_IDEA', Text: 'Please share one idea for improving team efficiency this year.', Type: Long free text. 
5. Activate the new 'Employee Pulse 2025' survey.

Login credentials: admin / Admin123!
